cause_quote: The original gallery ran `await image.decode();` and then `return item;`, so its cache retained the item and URL while the temporary `Image` became eligible for garbage collection.
user_saw: Going back to a recently viewed image in the chat lightbox could make it download again and visibly reload.
summary: The fix keeps each decoded Image alive while its gallery item is cached and updates the end-to-end test to detect duplicate requests after garbage collection.
reasoning: The commit that introduced gallery navigation already loaded attachments by URL and discarded the decoded Image, leaving revisits dependent on browser cache state. I checked that the Gateway served mutable media without validators before gallery navigation shipped and that later gallery refactors preserved the same decode-and-return behavior.
